question: Using cms_cost_report_uh_fy2022.json and cms_cost_report_uh_fy2023.json, compute Net Patient Revenue per FTE employee on payroll ('FTE - Employees on Payroll') for each year, then give the FY2023 value minus FY2022 value in dollars, rounded to the nearest dollar.
solve_py:
import os,csv,json
D=os.environ.get('DATA_DIR','/app/data')
def f(n):
    d=json.load(open(D+'/'+n))[0];return float(d['Net Patient Revenue'])/float(d['FTE - Employees on Payroll'])
print(round(f('cms_cost_report_uh_fy2023.json')-f('cms_cost_report_uh_fy2022.json')))
